key_idea: Bipartite matching with a capacity on groups of toys: model as max flow source->child->toy->category(cap r)->sink.
sketch: Edges: source->child cap 1, child->liked toy cap 1, toy->its category cap 1, category->sink cap r, and uncategorised toy->sink cap 1. Run Dinic; the graph has about 300 nodes and 10^4 edges so anything works. Pitfalls: p may be 0, and toys in no category are unrestricted; the category line lists l toys followed by r.
